title: Castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free scene: castle centered -->
  <!-- main keep -->
  <rect x='34' y='40' width='32' height='42' fill='#8ea6c9'/>
  <!-- keep roof battlements -->
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='7' height='8' fill='#8ea6c9'/>
  <rect x='46' y='34' width='7' height='8' fill='#8ea6c9'/>
  <rect x='58' y='34' width='8' height='8' fill='#8ea6c9'/>
  <!-- keep shading panel -->
  <rect x='34' y='40' width='32' height='6' fill='#a9bedb'/>
  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='16' y='30' width='16' height='52' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <!-- left tower battlements -->
  <rect x='16' y='24' width='5' height='8' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <rect x='24' y='24' width='8' height='8' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <!-- left tower roof cone -->
  <polygon points='16,30 24,14 32,30' fill='#d45a5a'/>
  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='68' y='30' width='16' height='52' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <!-- right tower battlements -->
  <rect x='68' y='24' width='8' height='8' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <rect x='79' y='24' width='5' height='8' fill='#b9c9e4'/>
  <!-- right tower roof cone -->
  <polygon points='68,30 76,14 84,30' fill='#d45a5a'/>
  <!-- central keep roof spire -->
  <polygon points='34,34 50,18 66,34' fill='#e08a3c'/>
  <!-- flag on spire -->
  <rect x='49' y='8' width='2' height='12' fill='#f5e06a'/>
  <polygon points='51,8 62,11 51,15' fill='#c7e86a'/>
  <!-- gate -->
  <path d='M42,82 L42,66 Q50,56 58,66 L58,82 Z' fill='#6b4f8f'/>
  <!-- gate arch highlight -->
  <path d='M42,82 L42,66 Q50,56 58,66' fill='none' stroke='#a98fd0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- gate plank lines -->
  <line x1='46' y1='67' x2='46' y2='82' stroke='#8f74b8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='63' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#8f74b8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='67' x2='54' y2='82' stroke='#8f74b8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- windows on keep -->
  <rect x='38' y='46' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='46' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='6' height='8' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <!-- windows on left tower -->
  <rect x='21' y='40' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <rect x='21' y='54' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <!-- windows on right tower -->
  <rect x='73' y='40' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <rect x='73' y='54' width='6' height='7' fill='#f8d76a'/>
  <!-- ground / grass base -->
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='10' fill='#5da05d'/>
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='3' fill='#7cc47c'/>
  <!-- little path to gate -->
  <path d='M46,92 L54,92 L58,82 L42,82 Z' fill='#c9b38a'/>
</svg>
